content:
Overview

Mount Pleasant is a city in SC with a population of 90,000. Charleston suburb with Shem Creek, the Ravenel Bridge, and top-rated schools. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
